domains.name: Expresión e interacción escritas (Written Expression and Interaction)
Expresión e interacción orales (Oral Expression and Interaction)

exam_name: SIELE (Servicio Internacional de Evaluación de la Lengua Española)
exam_price_notes: ~$150 USD for global exam; individual modules available at lower cost. Price varies by country.
exam_rules: No electronic devices or dictionaries. Oral exams conducted with examiner present or recorded. SIELE is fully computer-based.
id_requirements: Valid government-issued photo ID (Passport, National ID card, or equivalent)

lifecycle.summary: Confirmed current on the issuer host on 2026-09-15: Instituto Cervantes' SIELE page is live; siele.org offers 'RESERVA TU EXAMEN'.

official_study_resources.title: DELE Modelos de Examen (Official Sample Papers)

prerequisites.description: None; suitable for all non-native Spanish speakers (A1–C1)

renewal_options: DELE certificates have lifetime validity. SIELE is valid for 5 years.

retake_policy.notes: DELE: no limit on retakes; CCSE: can retake immediately if failed
